flow_ref: User story (not in the OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/HST/{suspension,revival}/form (halaman Manual HST), utils/data/LinkData.tsx; ocmsadminapi workflows/notice_management/suspension/{HstManagementController,HstManagementServiceImpl}; ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/datahiveuenfin/services/DataHiveUenFinService (work item placeholder). ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: tidak ada code terkait
note: Status 'No requirement' (requirement not given). The story asks the officer to decide through a work item whether the reminder is resent to the alternative address from the appeal, and for OCMS to confirm that decision. The work item does not exist: createWorkItemForNoAlternativeAddress only writes a log '[PLACEHOLDER] ... feature not ready' (DataHiveUenFinService.java:3697-3701), the Work Items menu in the staff portal is commented out (LinkData.tsx:398) and there is no /work-item route in App.tsx. There is no field, button, or record for 'resend / do not resend', and appeal data never reaches the HST pages. The only shortcut an officer has is the Manual HST pages: Apply HST Suspension (= do not resend) and Revival with a new address (= resend, as a side effect of revival). The decision itself is not stored.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. Only the Manual HST pages can be reused; the work item, appeal data with the alternative address, and a recorded resend decision do not exist. A requirement from URA is needed.

steps.step: A work item with the ID, notices and appeal details (including the alternative address) appears on the officer dashboard
steps.detail: createWorkItemForNoAlternativeAddress only writes the log '[PLACEHOLDER] Work item creation skipped ... feature not ready' (DataHiveUenFinService.java:3697-3701). The Work Items menu in the staff portal is commented out (LinkData.tsx:398) and App.tsx has no /work-item route. No code reads an appeal with its alternative address and creates a work item (that belongs to stories 20.15 and 20.24).

steps.step: Officer reviews the ID, outstanding notices and address to decide whether to resend
steps.detail: Manual HST Suspension page: entering the ID calls check-hst (checkType create), which returns the name and latest mha_reg address from ONOD (HstManagementServiceImpl.java:126-135, 201-227); the notice list comes from offencenoticeownerdriverlist (SearchIDForm.tsx:106-121). The appeal data and the alternative address from the appeal are not shown; no code brings appeal data to this page, so the officer has to type the address.

steps.step: Officer indicates the decision to resend the reminder to the alternative address
steps.detail: There is no 'resend' field or button. The closest is Manual HST Revival: the officer enters a new address and revive-hst writes it as furnished_mail with letter_address='Y' (HstManagementServiceImpl.java:572-617, line 607), lifts TS-HST and DELETES the HST record (line 466). So 'resend' is only a side effect of revival and the decision is not stored. Siblings: stories 20.25 and 20.26 (lift indicator and resend).

steps.step: Officer indicates the decision NOT to resend the reminder
steps.detail: The decision not to resend = the officer opens the HST > Manual HST Suspension menu and clicks Apply (App.tsx:196-200, LinkData.tsx:183-200). No decision field is stored and there is no link from a work item. Same fact as step 1 of story 20.18, so the fit is the same (Sebagian).

Confirmation is only the 'Confirm HST Suspension' pop-up (HSTSuspensionForm.tsx:110-115) or 'Confirm HST Revival' (HSTRevivalForm.tsx:72-74) followed by a success alert. No decision record is written and no work item is closed (there is no work item). The confirmation belongs to the HST action, not to a resend decision.
